body:
If you don’t follow Read the Spirit – here’s a great introduction:

 http://www.readthespirit.com/explore/2012/9/10/brian-mclaren-why-did-jesus-moses-mohammed.html

I had the privilege of being interviewed on Mormon Matters recently:

 http://mormonmatters.org/2012/08/29/123-124-emergence-christianity-and-mormonism/

I made it onto Salem Radio with Steve Brown, an outrageous guy: http://stevebrownetc.com/2012/09/07/why-did-jesus-moses-the-buddha-and-mohammed-cross-the-road-brian-mclaren-on-sbe/

I spoke with WGVU/NPR Grand Rapids recently too: http://www.wgvu.org/wgvunews/index.cfm?id=ct&sty=18031

The Relevant podcast interviewed me here: http://www.relevantmagazine.com/podcast/brian-mclaren
